parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT $1::uuid AS analysis_run_id
),

current_run AS (
    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.source,
        r.tender_id,
        r.tender_number,
        r.tender_external_id,
        r.status,
        r.documents_total,
        r.tender_meta,
        r.created_at,
        r.started_at,
        r.updated_at,
        r.ready_at,
        r.aggregation_started_at,
        r.completed_at
    FROM tender_analysis_runs AS r
    JOIN params AS p
      ON p.analysis_run_id = r.id
),

field_results_json AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'analysis_run_id', f.analysis_run_id,
                    'field_catalog_version', f.field_catalog_version,
                    'result_contract_version', f.result_contract_version,
                    'field_index', f.field_index,
                    'field_key', f.field_key,
                    'status', f.status,
                    'value_text', f.value_text,
                    'confidence', f.confidence,
                    'requires_human_review', f.requires_human_review,
                    'resolution_method', f.resolution_method,
                    'result_json', f.result_json
                )
                ORDER BY f.field_index
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS field_results
    FROM tender_analysis_field_results AS f
    JOIN params AS p
      ON p.analysis_run_id = f.analysis_run_id
),

documents_json AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', d.id,
                    'analysis_run_id', d.analysis_run_id,
                    'document_index', d.document_index,
                    'file_name', d.file_name,
                    'file_extension', d.file_extension,
                    'display_name', d.display_name,
                    'download_url', d.download_url,
                    'publication_at', d.publication_at,
                    'source_size', d.source_size,
                    'mime_type', d.mime_type,
                    'file_size', d.file_size,
                    'status', d.status,
                    'units_total', d.units_total,
                    'facts_count', d.facts_count
                )
                ORDER BY d.document_index
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS documents
    FROM tender_analysis_documents AS d
    JOIN params AS p
      ON p.analysis_run_id = d.analysis_run_id
),

facts_json AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', f.id,
                    'analysis_run_id', f.analysis_run_id,
                    'document_id', f.document_id,
                    'analysis_unit_id', f.analysis_unit_id,
                    'fact_index', f.fact_index,
                    'field_catalog_version', f.field_catalog_version,
                    'field_key', f.field_key,
                    'value_text', f.value_text,
                    'extractor_status', f.extractor_status,
                    'extractor_confidence', f.extractor_confidence,
                    'extractor_review_reason_code', f.extractor_review_reason_code,
                    'extractor_review_note', f.extractor_review_note,
                    'validator_verdict', f.validator_verdict,
                    'validator_confidence', f.validator_confidence,
                    'validator_reason_code', f.validator_reason_code,
                    'validator_reason_note', f.validator_reason_note,
                    'evidence', f.evidence,
                    'extractor_meta', f.extractor_meta,
                    'validator_meta', f.validator_meta
                )
                ORDER BY f.document_id, f.analysis_unit_id, f.fact_index
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS facts
    FROM tender_analysis_facts AS f
    JOIN params AS p
      ON p.analysis_run_id = f.analysis_run_id
),

units_json AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            jsonb_agg(
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'id', u.id,
                    'analysis_run_id', u.analysis_run_id,
                    'document_id', u.document_id,
                    'analysis_unit_id', u.analysis_unit_id,
                    'unit_index', u.unit_index,
                    'units_total', u.units_total,
                    'section_id', u.section_id,
                    'section_title', u.section_title,
                    'section_kind', u.section_kind,
                    'part_index', u.part_index,
                    'parts_total', u.parts_total,
                    'source_pages', u.source_pages,
                    'analysis_unit', u.analysis_unit,
                    'ai_segments', u.ai_segments,
                    'provenance', u.provenance
                )
                ORDER BY d.document_index, u.unit_index, u.analysis_unit_id
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS units
    FROM tender_analysis_units AS u
    JOIN tender_analysis_documents AS d
      ON d.id = u.document_id
     AND d.analysis_run_id = u.analysis_run_id
    JOIN params AS p
      ON p.analysis_run_id = u.analysis_run_id
)

SELECT
    (
        SELECT r.id
        FROM current_run AS r
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS analysis_run_id,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'analysis_run',
            (SELECT to_jsonb(r) FROM current_run AS r),
        'field_results',
            fr.field_results,
        'documents',
            d.documents,
        'facts',
            fa.facts,
        'units',
            u.units
    ) AS snapshot
FROM params AS p
CROSS JOIN field_results_json AS fr
CROSS JOIN documents_json AS d
CROSS JOIN facts_json AS fa
CROSS JOIN units_json AS u;

SELECT
    field_index,
    field_key,
    status,
    value_text,
    confidence,
    requires_human_review,
    resolution_method,
    result_json
FROM tender_analysis_field_results
WHERE analysis_run_id = $1
ORDER BY field_index;
